__comment: Branch protection payload for both main and staging. Applied with: gh api -X PUT repos/SSerafinn/lakbayan_alpha/branches/<branch>/protection --input .github/branch-protection.json. Kept in the repo so both branches get identical rules and the intent is reviewable — see docs/REPO_SETTINGS.md.
__comment_reviews: required_approving_review_count is 0 while @SSerafinn is the only active reviewer. GitHub does not permit approving your own pull request — that is a platform rule with no setting to disable — so requiring 1 approval makes every PR unmergeable for a solo maintainer. Raise this to 1 and set require_code_owner_reviews true once the other two developers are reviewing. The protections that actually prevented our incidents are the status checks and strict below, not the approval count.
